summary: Varargs formatted-write wrapper around a stream/buffer object a1 with a format string a2. Enters the stream's critical section via StreamBufferLockViaCriticalSection, captures buffer state with sub_58E41B, performs the formatted write with the va_list through sub_58D04D, conditionally clears struct fields via ClearStructFieldsIfFlagSet using the captured state, leaves the critical section with AddressRangeCriticalSectionLeave, and returns the formatted-write result.

local_names.a1: stream/buffer object whose state is locked, written and unlocked
local_names.a2: format string passed through to the formatted write
local_names.va: varargs list consumed by the formatted write
local_names.v2: buffer state captured before the write (used to decide field clearing)
local_names.v3: return value of the formatted write, propagated as the function result

operations.description: Enter the stream's critical section with StreamBufferLockViaCriticalSection(a1)
Capture the buffer/struct state from a1 with sub_58E41B, stored in v2
Run the formatted write sub_58D04D(a1, a2, va) with the varargs list; its result is kept in v3
When the captured state's flag is set, clear struct fields via ClearStructFieldsIfFlagSet(v2, a1)
Leave the critical section with AddressRangeCriticalSectionLeave(a1)
Used by logging and file-writer paths including TraceLogInit, ResourcePathBuilder, SceneFileTEAMDIRVEHDIRNOTSPINWriter and WeatherConditionsFileWriter
